summaries.1: Bab I defines Satu Data Indonesia as government data governance so that data are accurate, up to date, integrated, accountable, accessible, and shareable through standards, metadata, interoperability, reference codes, and master data.
summaries.2: Bab II sets the four Satu Data principles and details data standards, metadata, interoperability, and reference/master data.
summaries.3: Bab III organises central and regional roles: Steering Board, Pembina Data, Walidata, producers, the One Data Forum, and secretariats.
summaries.4: Bab IV covers the lifecycle: planning (including priority data), collection, examination, and dissemination via Portal Satu Data Indonesia, including access without fees or MoUs.
summaries.5: Bab V allocates funding from the state budget, regional budgets, and other lawful sources.
summaries.6: Bab VI lets independent public bodies (BI, OJK, BPJS, and others) participate without reducing their statutory independence.
summaries.7: Bab VII contains transitional arrangements for existing data-governance practices.
summaries.8: Bab VIII repeals conflicting provisions as specified and brings the Perpres into force on promulgation.
